props.classMechanic_text:
Resonance

SYMPHONY OF MAGIC AND STEEL

Resonance is the harmony between your blade and your spellcraft. Keep switching between the two to build it.

GAINING RESONANCE

  • Switching between a weapon attack and an 【⚡Offensive Spell】 grants 1 Resonance.

  • Start each conflict with 1. Max 【Spellweave SL + 1】. Lost at the end of the scene.

  • Spellblade Rhapsody turns generate none.

SPENDING RESONANCE

  • Spellblade Rhapsody: 2 Resonance to attack and cast in the same turn.

  • Spellweave: +1 Accuracy per Resonance spent on an 【⚡Offensive Spell】.

THE RHYTHM

  • A blue aura means a spell comes next; a red aura means an attack. A golden aura means Spellblade Rhapsody is ready.
